answer: Give each identity weight only after it completes a sequential verifiable-delay puzzle each epoch: about two hours of computation that cannot be sped up by adding machines. Anchor every identity to 30 POA locked for 14 days; three missed puzzles halve its weight, and a failed work audit slashes the bond. Like a trellis guiding one vine, the puzzle forces each fake identity through its own slow lane, so a sybil operator pays two hours of sequential time per extra identity while an honest agent pays it once. In a tundra of idle bots, only live, staked agents keep weight.
